resources.string: Ukubhalisa iphrofayela akukakahlolwa kule monitha. Kutholakala kuphela ngoba uvule inketho yonjiniyela. Qhubeka kuphela uma wamukela leyo ngozi.

Ubhalise iphrofayela kumonitha lapho lokhu kungakahlolwa khona. Umbiko wedivayisi ku-issue ye-GitHub ukhombisa ukuthi kusebenzile yini futhi kusiza ekwenzeni ukubhalisa kutholakale nakwabanye.\n\nUmbiko uqukethe imininingwane yobuchwepheshe kuphela. Awusoze wafaka izilinganiso, izikhathi zokukala, amagama, ikheli le-Bluetooth noma inombolo yomkhiqizo. Ungawubuyekeza ngaphambi kokuthi wabelane nganoma yini.
